_doc: Split-K tiling for the 32x32-block FP8 GEMM, keyed by projection shape, capture mode and row band.
Two rows per shape because the band differs: a captured launch admits fewer rows than an eager one.
There is deliberately no all-wildcard row: an unseen projection must fail closed, because the split-K path only wins for the shapes below.

tactics.note: measured on MTT S5000 with a cold L2 for the DeepSeek-V4.1 TP8 projections; carried over from the pre-table constants at 0b155a2618, so this row is as good as that measurement and no better
